item.title: Hakata Machiya Folk Museum — Guide
item.description: The Hakata Machiya Folk Museum, right across from Kushida Shrine, offers an engaging window into the life and culture of old Hakata. Housed in restored machiya — traditional wooden townhouses from the Meiji era — it recreates the world of the district’s merchants and craftsmen a century ago, with period rooms, everyday objects and exhibits on Hakata’s history and its great Yamakasa festival. You can also see demonstrations of the region’s traditional crafts, including Hakata-ori silk weaving and the making of Hakata dolls, and often try simple hands-on activities.
